newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in lively trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in lively trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in lively trade on Tuesday, with blue chips accounting for most of the activity.
* Eight of 15 active issues fell and seven rose.
* Volume rose fivefold from Friday to 15,692 shares and turnover tenfold to 14.2 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was textile company Varteks adding 8.1 percent to 80 kuna on volume of 1,800 units.
* Zagrebacka Banka ordinary shares led losers, dropping 40 kuna to 2,160 with 3,778 shares traded.
* Most actively traded stock was Pliva pharmaceutical which inched down one kuna to 475 on volume of 5,272 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
